dateline: Six BTS members — RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin and V — returned to Incheon International Airport on Sept 20 following their iHeartRadio Music Festival run in Las Vegas, sharing Chuseok holiday wishes with fans; Jungkook, who stayed behind for an individual US schedule, followed on Sept 21, bringing the full group home days ahead of the Sept 24-26 Chuseok holiday. The homecoming caps a festival stand that drew ARMY criticism over the brevity and production of BTS's Sept 18 set. The ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá on Oct 2-3, followed by Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo through October.
heroHeadline: Day 4,848: Full Group Reunites in Seoul Ahead of Chuseok After Las Vegas Festival Run
heroSubtitle: September 21, 2026 is Day 4,848 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin and V arrived back at Incheon International Airport on Sept 20 following the group's headline set closing night one of the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas (Sept 18), greeting fans and wishing them a happy Chuseok. Jungkook, who remained in the US for an individual schedule, followed a day later on Sept 21, reuniting the full seven-member group in South Korea days ahead of the Sept 24-26 Chuseok (Hangawi) holiday. The reunion follows ARMY criticism of the brevity and production of BTS's roughly 16-minute iHeartRadio set. The tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3 before continuing to Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
